Commit a1c7d415f4bb7b947c4c2e47faf220b0148f4bac
Local changes (2026-09-21): common.h uses explicit signed differences for abs;
init.c converts negative chroma to signed int before adding 128, avoiding
undefined float-to-unsigned conversion. Filter patterns are unchanged.
AUTHORS, README, COPYING and filter sources are unmodified.
LGPL-2.1-or-later. Complete library source included here.

To modify/replace the library in the app: copy the app to a writable folder,
install Apple Command Line Tools, edit the sources here and run sh rebuild.sh.
The universal library is replaceable; library validation is not enabled.
Reverse engineering the app to debug modifications to this library is permitted.

Native dos-scaler changes (2026-10-17):
common.h replaces the 16,777,216-entry (64 MiB) RGBtoYUV table with exact
integer /1000 conversion. init.c retains a no-op hqxInit symbol. This also
matches the integer color conversion of this project's FFmpeg HQ3x reference,
which differs at a few truncation boundaries from the floating-point upstream
initialization. HQ2x/HQ3x/HQ4x pattern and blend sources remain unchanged.
This copy is built as a separate replaceable shared library (dos_hqx).
It is not the emulator app binary; rebuild with the native CMake project.
